definitions.explanation: A solid substance in which atoms or molecules are arranged in a regular, repeating pattern. Also the process of forming such a structure.
The tangible result or culmination of sustained effort, love, or dedication. A figurative extension of the crystallization metaphor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結晶|けっしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{結晶|けっしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{結晶|けっしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}した→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I observed the crystal structure under a microscope.

examples.notes: A common expression referring to a child born of a loving relationship.

notes:
USAGE:
Also functions as a suru verb: {結晶|けっしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to crystallize). The figurative sense 2 is very common in everyday Japanese, especially the phrase ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結晶|けっしょう} (fruit of love, i.e., a child).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結晶|けっしょう}: snow crystal
- {結晶|けっしょう}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: crystal structure
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結晶|けっしょう}: fruit of love (a child)
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結晶|けっしょう}: fruit of one's efforts
